scope: 虚构教学数据；本地内存数据库；仅证明这组输入输出，不是性能测试

filter_in_where.sql: SELECT u.name, o.id, o.status FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id=u.id WHERE o.status='paid' ORDER BY u.id;

filter_in_on.sql: SELECT u.name, o.id, o.status FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id=u.id AND o.status='paid' ORDER BY u.id;

or_null_in_where.sql: SELECT u.name, o.id, o.status FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id=u.id WHERE o.status='paid' OR o.id IS NULL ORDER BY u.id;

count_paid.sql: SELECT u.name, COUNT(o.id) AS paid_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id=u.id AND o.status='paid' GROUP BY u.id, u.name ORDER BY u.id;
